name: disk-nix-gc-advisor
description: Advise on disk / Nix store cleanup when usage is high (read-only, never GC)
goal: Disk or Nix store usage appears high. Call disk_nix_report and list_boot_generations. Summarize what is using space and list SAFE cleanup options the user could run manually (e.g. review old generations, nix-collect-garbage after understanding impact). Do NOT run destructive commands, do NOT delete files, do NOT execute GC. End with a short prioritized checklist.
